description: Answers "How did my backtest do?" with total return, CAGR, max drawdown, Sharpe and the equity curve for one saved backtest. Use a backtestId from list_backtests or backtest_status. Results are simulated. Never starts or changes a backtest. Read-only. Shows an interactive panel in apps that support MCP Apps; always returns a text summary and a botspot.trade link.
name: show_backtest_dashboard
title: Show backtest performance
